metadata.title: Generate Test Results Report
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Generate HTML and markdown test results reports from evidence files. Open HTML report in browser for review.

output.description: test-results.html + test-results.md with pass/fail summary, step details, evidence links

specificActions: Read all evidence JSON files from output directory
Generate interactive HTML report and markdown report
bestPractices: CRITICAL: Every entry in HTML evidenceData MUST be sourced from saved evidence JSON files
If evidence file missing for a step, set to {missing: true, reason: 'Evidence file not found'}
NEVER generate evidence from memory, inference, or conversation context
NEVER invent or approximate bucket names, S3 keys, API response bodies, status codes

substeps.name: Read evidence files
substeps.description: Load all evidence from output directory
actions: For each test step, read the corresponding evidence JSON file
Use input, output, and assertion fields to populate report data
If file missing, mark as missing

substeps.name: Generate HTML report
actions: Summary header with pass rate percentage
Expandable test case cards with step details
Precondition context panel per test case (when setup steps exist)

substeps.name: Generate markdown report
actions: Header with suite ID, timestamp, environment, summary
Results table per test case with step details

substeps.name: Open HTML in browser
actions: Open test-results.html in default browser (Invoke-Item on Windows, open on macOS)

substeps.name: Display summary
actions: Links to HTML and markdown reports

substeps.name: End-Step: Compliance Check
actions: Output: '✓ Step completed in compliance with operating principles'

flow.description: Read evidence → generate HTML → generate markdown → open browser → display summary

memoryFileUsage.readFrom: Test execution results and evidence files
